The examination of the course consists of two parts: 

- a short essay (1-2 pages) following the seminar on Day 4
- a group project on multi omics data, with presentation the **30rd October**.


#### Details on the group project
The goal is for the students to perform omics data analysis using the methodologies presented in the course.

** Datasets **
During the first day of the course, we will present three multi-omics datasets. 
And, for each dataset, we will propose two different objectives, for a total of six different projects.

** Groups **
The students will be divided into grups of 4-5, which will be communicated during the first week of the course.
The students will be able to express their preferred dataset, but we may not be able to satisfy everyone.

** Presentations **
All presentations will be held the **30rd October 2025**, via zoom (the link will be communicated during the course).
The presentations will be organized in sessions, one per every dataset.

Key points: 
- It is mandatory to be present at both presentation
- Each presentation should last approximately 30 minutes, followed by 10 minutes of discussion (with questions from the other group). 
- Everybody should contribute.
- Suggested skeleton: brief background, figures generated, methods (why were they chosen), conclusions, limitations.
